 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018
ORAL ORDER 1.
This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
2. Mr. Hardik Soni, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / settlement pursis, which is taken on record.
The withdrawal / settlement pursis is signed by the authorized signatory, who is present in person before this Lok Adalat and letter of authority.

3. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and R/CR.A/633/2012 ORDER Standard Act, 2006.

sentences.text:

1 4.
Today, respondent no.3-Kamleshkumar Karshandas Chaudhary is present before the Court.

He has produced the authorization letter issued by the remaining respondents namely Prakashbhai Karshanbhai Chaudhary, Harilal Virsangbhai Chaudhary, Ishvarbhai Ramjibhai Chaudhary,
Pathubhai Meghjibhai Chaudhary and Ganeshbhai Meghjibhai Chauhdary.

In the authorization letter, the respondents No. 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 have put their signatures along with their photographs and their signatures are identified by Mr. Hitesh Raval, learned advocate in the authorization letter.
Learned advocate Mr. Hitesh Raval is present before the court and stated that these respondents are known to him and confirmed their signatures in the authorization letter.

Respondent No.3 stated that whatever decision will be taken by this Court in the Lok Adalat the same would be binding to all the respondents and he is authorized to act accordingly on behalf of the remaining respondents and he himself along with authorization letter, zerox copy of PAN card, etc., are also produced on record,
which are also taken on record.
The authorization letter in original executed on the stamp paper of Rs. 100/- duly notarized on 20.04.2018 is produced before the court and is also taken on record.
R/CR.A/633/2012 ORDER 5.
In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.

The respondent No. 2 is directed to pay a sum of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand Only) and each of the respondents No. 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 are directed to pay Rs. 3,000/-(Rupees Three Thousand only)
and thus, in all, the respondent No.2 to deposit Rs. 5,000/- and the respondents No. 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 6 to deposit Rs. 18,000/- towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties, in lieu thereof.
Necessary cost be deposited in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within four weeks, failing which the Appeal shall stand revived automatically.
Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.

6. However, disposal of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same,
incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this order will not be treated as a precedent in any future case for reference.

(B.N. KARIA, J.) Chairman ksdarji State Of Gujarat vs Ganesh Monghaji Chaudhary-M/S ... on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130817733/
